data.title: Flexsteel Industries, Inc. to Participate in the Lytham Partners Fall 2026 Investor Conference
data.description: Flexsteel Industries, Inc. (NASDAQ:FLXS), a prominent residential furniture manufacturer in the United States, is set to be part of the Lytham Partners Fall 2026 Investor Conference, held online on September 29-30, 2026. The company will engage in a webcast presentation at 1:00 p.m. ET on Tuesday, September 29, 20 and conduct individual meetings with investors during the conference. Flexsteel is known for its large scale operations in the furniture market and this event will offer an opportunity for investors to interact with the company's representatives.

data.title: Edison International, Southern California Edison Declare Dividends
data.description: In Rosemead, California, the board of directors of Edison International (NYSE: EIX) announced a quarterly common stock dividend of $0.8775 per share to be paid on October 31, 2026, for shareholders of record on October 7, 2026. Southern California Edison's board of directors also declared dividends for shareholders of record on December 14, 2026, payable on December 15, 2026: Series G Preference Stock to receive $0.31875 per security.

data.title: Reminder: HHH 2026 Annual Shareholder Meeting Set for September 30
data.description: A meeting is scheduled to commence at 9 a.m. Eastern Time at 787 Seventh Avenue in New York City today.

data.title: Indonesia Energy Announces Availability of Financial Results
data.description: Indonesia Energy Corporation (NYSE American: INDO), based in Jakarta, Indonesia and Danville, CA, disclosed its unaudited financial performance for the first half of 2026 following NYSE American guidelines. Specializing in oil and gas exploration in Indonesia, the company shared the results for the six months terminating on June 30, 2026.

data.title: Crescent Biopharma Announces Grants of Inducement Awards
data.description: On September 25, 2026, Crescent Biopharma, Inc. (Nasdaq: CBIO) in Waltham, Mass., declared that the Compensation Committee of its Board of Directors sanctioned the allocation of options enabling the purchase of a total of 31,200 shares of the Company’s ordinary shares to two non-executive employees. This was done as equity inducement awards under the Crescent Biopharma, Inc. 2025 Employment Inducement Incentive Award Plan. These options, approved on September 24, 2026, were significant in securing the employment of each individual with Crescent, as per Nasdaq Listing Rule 5635(c)(4).

data.title: Marvell Technology, Inc. Declares Quarterly Dividend Payment
data.description: A company in Santa Clara, California, Marvell Technology, Inc. (NASDAQ: MRVL), has recently disclosed a quarterly dividend of $0.06 per share of common stock, encompassing preferred stock converted to common stock, to be disbursed on October 29, 2026. This dividend is for stockholders recorded as of October 9, 2026. Marvell is dedicated to providing data infrastructure technology that interconnects the globe, emphasizing collaborations with customers as the pivotal framework for developing solutions. Trusted globally for its initiatives and utilities, Marvell is at the forefront of technological advancement.

data.title: Thimble and Bold Penguin Launch AI-Powered Integration to Streamline Insurance Quoting
data.description: In New York, a prominent digital small business Managing General Agent (MGA), Thimble, has revealed a recent collaboration and integration with Bold Penguin, United States' biggest insurance distribution platform. The partnership involves the development of a tool that enables their platforms to independently identify, communicate, and complete small business quoting activities through AI agent-to-agent communication. This integration empowers Bold Penguin users to utilize AI-supported natural language processing to efficiently generate and finalize quotes.

data.title: U.N. reveals list of firms linked to Israeli settlements in West Bank; Israel denounces move as a "smear campaign."
data.description: Israel strongly criticized the compilation of a database containing companies involved in operations in the occupied West Bank, denouncing it as a biased "tool for political purposes" aimed at tarnishing their reputation.

data.title: HUB Cyber Security Announces Receipt of Nasdaq Notification Regarding Market Value of Listed Securities Requirement
data.description: Tel Aviv-based HUB Cyber Security Ltd. (Nasdaq: HUBC) disclosed today that it was notified by The Nasdaq Stock Market LLC on September 23, 2026, that it currently does not meet the Nasdaq Listing Rule 5550(b)(2) standards, mandating a minimum Market Value of Listed Securities of US$35 million (MVLS) for sustained listing on The Nasdaq Capital Market. This notification, as per Nasdaq Listing Rule 5810(b), necessitates immediate disclosure of receiving a deficiency notification. The Company's ordinary shares, trading under the ticker "HUBC," remain unaffected and will continue trading on Nasdaq despite this notification.

data.title: SB Financial Group, Inc. Announces Schedule for Third Quarter 2026 Results
data.description: SB Financial Group, Inc., a financial services company traded on NASDAQ under the symbol SBFG, with a wide range of services including community banking, mortgage banking, wealth management, private client, and title insurance, plans to announce its Q3 2026 financial results on October 22, 2026, before the market opens. They will conduct a conference call and webcast on the same day at 3:30 p.m. EDT.

data.description: Sysco Corporation revealed the closure of a public offering today, including Sysco and Sysco Holdings Corporation. The offering involved C$1.5 billion in total senior notes. These notes were issued as part of the Offering and include various securities.

data.title: U.S. Conference of Mayors Launches National Affordability Tour
data.description: A national tour organized by the U.S. Conference of Mayors is set to bring together mayors, local leaders, and community members across four cities to address the increasing cost of living. Launching in San Diego on September 25, 2026, the tour aims to spotlight strategies and remedies for this pressing issue.

data.title: Taiwan Tourism Workshop in LA Highlights Taiwan's 24/7 Experiences and 100 Ways to Wonder
data.description: Around 70 travel professionals from Southern California recently engaged with Taiwan's tourism industry at an event held in Los Angeles on September 18, 2026. The workshop, organized by the Taiwan Tourism Administration (TTA), marked the conclusion of the U.S. workshop series. This event served as a platform for forging connections and partnerships between the participants and the Taiwan tourism sector, aiming to boost tourism between the two regions.

data.title: Taiwan Tourism Workshop Returns to Chicago After Seven Years, Connecting Taiwan with Local Travel Industry
data.description: Taiwan Tourism Administration (TTA) introduced its "Taiwan Never Sleep" campaign in Chicago on September 16, 2026. Featuring over 200 direct flights from North America, Taiwan beckons travelers to explore its charms. The TTA conducted the second leg of a three-city U.S. workshop series in Chicago.

data.title: U.S. Senators Tillis, Padilla Introduce Legislation to Accelerate Research Against Leading Cause of Death in U.S.
data.description: ASANA Voices is taking steps to combat cardiovascular disease by calling for the creation of a foundation that will bring together public, private, and philanthropic resources to support further research. This initiative comes as bipartisan legislation was introduced in Washington on September 25, 2026. The foundation aims to mobilize resources to enhance research efforts aimed at addressing cardiovascular disease.

data.title: /C O R R E C T I O N -- Brookfield Residential/
data.description: After six months since the groundbreaking ceremony, six families from Altadena have officially moved into their newly rebuilt homes. This update was provided by Brookfield Residential on 21-Sep-2026. The new development signifies progress as the community rebuilds following a significant event. The families are now settled in their new homes, marking a positive step forward in the restoration process.

data.title: Rexel to Acquire GCG, a Leading Specialty Wire & Cable Distribution Platform
data.description: On September 25, 2026, in Chicago, GCG, a prominent specialist in wire and cable distribution for crucial uses, disclosed that Rexel, a publicly traded company dealing in energy management products and services, will be purchasing GCG.

data.title: RND Automation Showcases Packaging, Live Pouching and Risk Reduction at PACK EXPO International 2026
data.description: At the upcoming trade show in Chicago on September 25, 2026, Booth N-5115 will present various innovative technologies. These include live demonstrations of KANGA pouching, QuickPouch packaging equipment, and RND's High-Risk Test Bench. Attendees can also experience package-integrity testing and see real-world robotics applications in action. RND Automation will highlight its diverse packaging-equipment lineup at the event.
